suread: review R1 素读（只读 text/，未开 md）

facts.fact: 当天傍晚，她下定决心不再想三件事
facts.anchor: That evening, I was determined to stop thinking about the figure I’d seen in the window

facts.fact: 三件事之二：与 Harrison 那次让人糊涂的时刻
facts.anchor: the confusing moment with Harrison

facts.fact: 三件事之三：尸骸那场灾难
facts.anchor: and the carcass fiasco

facts.fact: 她躲进一种对一个陌生过去的乡愁里
facts.anchor: Hoping to lose myself in nostalgia for an unfamiliar past

facts.fact: 地点：退到 patio，带着从 Leon 房间拿的宝丽来
facts.anchor: I retreated to the patio with the Polaroids I’d taken from Uncle Leon’s room

facts.fact: 她没去动他的锁箱，理由是不想让 Gazzie 不悦
facts.anchor: I left his lockbox alone to avoid upsetting Gazzie

facts.fact: 她忍不住注意到：没有一样自然的东西碰过 Greer House
facts.anchor: nothing natural ever touched Greer House

facts.fact: 具体两项：没有杂草贴上外墙，没有蜥蜴爬过窗
facts.anchor: no weeds brushed up against the siding, no lizards crawled across the windows

facts.fact: 橡树垂下的咖啡馆串灯之下，她几乎能相信一切正常
facts.anchor: under the café lights dangling from the oak tree, I could almost believe everything was normal

facts.fact: 她此前就注意到：Leon 坐在几乎每张照片的边缘
facts.anchor: Leon sat in the outskirts of nearly every photo

facts.fact: 他眼下有黑眼圈
facts.anchor: dark circles under his eyes

facts.fact: 他只在速写本上涂画时才显得快乐
facts.anchor: He only looked happy when he was scribbling away in one of his sketchbooks

facts.fact: 她意识到自己不认得 Leon 去得最多的那间房
facts.anchor: I realized I didn’t recognize the room he frequented the most

facts.fact: 那间房奶油色的墙是半玻璃的，不是温室的全玻璃
facts.anchor: Its cream walls were half-glass—not the conservatory’s full-glass walls

facts.fact: 地上铺着红色波斯地毯
facts.anchor: a red Persian rug lined the floor

facts.fact: 照片一：他躺在红色沙发上，胸前放着 Walkman，头戴耳机
facts.anchor: he lay on a red couch, Walkman on his chest, headphones over his ears

facts.fact: 照片二：他蜷在胖乎乎的紫色椅子里速写
facts.anchor: he curled up in a plump purple chair, scribbling in his sketchbook

facts.fact: 照片三：他蹲在藤制书架旁，一根手指压在笔记本书脊上
facts.anchor: he crouched by a rattan bookcase, one finger on a notebook’s spine

facts.fact: 她的推断：找到那间房就能找到他的部分速写本
facts.anchor: If I found that room, I would find some of his sketchbooks

facts.fact: 她说她对此确信
facts.anchor: I was sure of it

facts.fact: 她认出窗外景色：就是她当下坐着的橡树根部
facts.anchor: I recognized the view outside the room’s window: the base of the oak tree, where I was currently sitting

facts.fact: 她跳起来，快步走进屋里
facts.anchor: Jumping up, I power walked inside

facts.fact: 排除：那间密室不连温室也不连厨房
facts.anchor: The mystery space wasn’t connected to the conservatory or kitchen

facts.fact: 从厨房窗口她看到房子西侧凸出一间小房
facts.anchor: from the kitchen window, I spotted a small room jutting from the house’s western side

facts.fact: 她的假设：Leon 的藏身处可能连着客厅，也许漏看了一组折叠拉门
facts.anchor: Maybe Uncle Leon’s hideaway was connected to the parlor? I could have missed a set of pocket doors

facts.fact: 经过 Ida 画像时她把目光钉在画像上
facts.anchor: In the parlor, I kept my eyes trained on Ida as I passed by her

facts.fact: 画框的贝母棕榈叶需要打理
facts.anchor: Her frame’s mother-of-pearl palm fronds needed attention

facts.fact: 少数仍闪出虹彩的淡紫或粉，多数已是暗淡的骨白
facts.anchor: While some of them shone an iridescent lavender or pink, most were a dull bone white

facts.fact: 她想得告诉 Gazzie：若她会补金箔，也许也能换贝母
facts.anchor: I’d have to tell Gazzie; if she knew how to reapply gold leaf, maybe she could also replace mother-of-pearl

facts.fact: 客厅后方她用手沿墙摸，指尖卡在一道几乎不可察的缝上
facts.anchor: I ran my hands along the walls until my fingers snagged on a nearly undetectable seam

facts.fact: 那是一扇暗装的齐平门
facts.anchor: a hidden flush-mounted door

facts.fact: 难怪她以前没注意到
facts.anchor: No wonder I hadn’t noticed it

facts.fact: 推门时她觉得 Ida 的目光落在她后脑
facts.anchor: it was like I could feel Ida’s eyes on the back of my head

facts.fact: 灰尘涌出，她打了个喷嚏
facts.anchor: Dust billowed out, and I sneezed

facts.fact: 显然女仆们不碰这间房
facts.anchor: Apparently, the maids didn’t touch this room

facts.fact: 鉴于她们平日的一丝不苟，她断定这是直接命令
facts.anchor: Given how meticulous they usually were, I assumed that must be a direct order

facts.fact: Gazzie 与 Virginia 姨妈也许抹掉了楼上关于 Leon 的一切，但这间密室里满是他的东西
facts.anchor: Gazzie and Aunt Virginia might have erased all signs of Uncle Leon upstairs, but his stuff was all over this secret room

facts.fact: 角落立着收起来的画架，旁边一整推车绘画用品
facts.anchor: An easel sat folded up in one corner, next to a rolling cart plumb full of painting supplies

facts.fact: 她独自笑着翻他的材料
facts.anchor: Smiling to myself, I riffled through his materials

facts.fact: 毛笔旧但干净，比她买得起的高级；颜料盖子结壳
facts.anchor: worn but clean brushes, much fancier than I could afford, and oils with crusty caps

facts.fact: 它们还能用：油画颜料不会坏
facts.anchor: They were still usable; oils never went bad

facts.fact: 对面墙立着藤制书架
facts.anchor: a rattan bookshelf stood

facts.fact: 上层是绘画书，下面排着黑色本子
facts.anchor: Painting books lined the upper shelves, below them black notebooks

facts.fact: 心跳着，她抓出一把
facts.anchor: Heart pounding, I pulled out a handful

facts.fact: 本能是想带回自己房间，但她否掉了
facts.anchor: My instinct was to retreat with them to my room, but I decided against it

facts.fact: 她给的理由：既然 Gazzie 已主动讲过 Leon，为什么要藏
facts.anchor: Why hide the fact that I was learning about my uncle, especially when Gazzie had already opened up about him?

facts.fact: 她坐进紫色扶手椅，掰开第一本
facts.anchor: Settling into the purple armchair, I cracked the first sketchbook open

facts.fact: 第一页底有签名：Leon K. Greer
facts.anchor: a signature: Leon K. Greer

facts.fact: 签名下是日期 1983
facts.anchor: Below it was a date: 1983

facts.fact: 那年他十六岁
facts.anchor: He’d been sixteen

facts.fact: 她翻页翻得太快差点撕破
facts.anchor: I flipped the page so fast I nearly ripped it

facts.fact: 随后一头沉进叔叔脑子里的 confines
facts.anchor: fell deep into the confines of my uncle’s mind

facts.fact: 评价：他是出色的画家，线条自信、透视准确
facts.anchor: his lines confident, perspective accurate

facts.fact: 对照：她的痴迷是生活不那么好看的一面，他的是日常人性
facts.anchor: Where my obsession was the more unsavory side of life, his was mundane humanity

facts.fact: 速写：卷发的男老师尴尬地坐在课本上
facts.anchor: a curly-haired male teacher awkwardly perched over a textbook

facts.fact: 速写：野餐桌上大笑的少年
facts.anchor: teenagers laughing at a picnic table

facts.fact: 速写：塌鼻子红发女孩探出车窗
facts.anchor: a small-nosed girl with red hair hanging out a car window

facts.fact: 他用红色水彩填头发再用钢笔勾边
facts.anchor: He’d filled in her hair with red watercolor, then outlined it in pen

facts.fact: 暑假开始有证据：瘦削的男孩咧嘴笑着驶向夕阳离开校园
facts.anchor: evidenced by a thin, grinning boy flicking off the campus as he drove into the sunset

facts.fact: 暑假之后 Mama 开始出现在几页里，每页都在笑
facts.anchor: Mama began to feature in a few pages, laughing in all of them

facts.fact: 和在宝丽来里一样
facts.anchor: as she had in the Polaroids

facts.fact: 每页他都写一条短记
facts.anchor: On each page, Leon had written a short entry

facts.fact: 短记一：看看这白痴
facts.anchor: Get a load of this idiot

facts.fact: 短记二：Jeannette 拒绝了约会，但明天一起吃冰淇淋——什么意思
facts.anchor: Jeannette said no to a date, but we’re meeting up for ice cream tomorrow. What does that mean?

facts.fact: 短记三：给 Aunt V 带花去医院；Mom 忙得不去探望——惊奇
facts.anchor: Brought Aunt V flowers at the hospital. Mom too busy to visit. Shocker

facts.fact: 她的评价：这些短记就是她对青少年的预期，阴郁、过度聚焦身边的人
facts.anchor: sullen and hyperfocused on the people around him

facts.fact: 同样的模式重复在接下来两本里
facts.anchor: The same patterns repeated across the next two sketchbooks

facts.fact: 然后是一本标着 1985——他死的那一年
facts.anchor: Then I came to one dated 1985—the year he’d died

facts.fact: 她的假设：若这是最后一本，他最后的想法就在里面
facts.anchor: If it was his last sketchbook, his final thoughts would be inside

facts.fact: 其中大概包括 Mama 与 Gazzie 争吵的某种迹象
facts.anchor: including, presumably, some indication of the fights Mama had had with Gazzie

facts.fact: 翻到第一页时她手指已被汗浸湿
facts.anchor: My fingers were damp with sweat by the time I turned the first page

facts.fact: 最后一个高中学期比平常用色更多
facts.anchor: He’d sketched his last high school semester with more color than usual

facts.fact: 速写：沾着紫颜料的手打开佛蒙特大学的录取信
facts.anchor: his hands, stained with purple paint, opening an acceptance letter from the University of Vermont

facts.fact: 速写：高瘦的男孩把一只亮绿的梨丢进垃圾桶
facts.anchor: the tall, thin boy tossing a bright green pear in the trash

facts.fact: 速写：戴红色小丑假发的演讲者在毕业典礼上摆姿势
facts.anchor: a speaker in a red clown wig posturing at his graduation ceremony

facts.fact: 那天的话照例阴郁，但因为她知道他的悲剧性事故而格外让人心碎
facts.anchor: given my knowledge of his tragic accident, particularly heartbreaking

facts.fact: 短记四：不知道怎么付学费，但这个天才说只要下决心没人能挡；他没遇过 Mom
facts.anchor: Not sure how I’ll pay for my degree, but this genius here says if I’m determined, nothing and no one can stop me. Clearly, he’s never met Mom

facts.fact: 她的推断：Gazzie 拒绝出学费，并劝他留在农场
facts.anchor: Gazzie had refused to pay for his schooling and was trying to convince him to stay at the farm

facts.fact: 她总结他的感受：他觉得被困住
facts.anchor: He’d felt trapped

facts.fact: 短记变得更离谱，像他在朋友离开 Amelia Island 后退回自己脑中
facts.anchor: like he’d retreated into his mind as his friends left Amelia Island for bright futures

facts.fact: 速写：一间着火的棚子
facts.anchor: He’d sketched a shed in flames

facts.fact: 速写：月光下两个阴影般的人影在橡树下密谋
facts.anchor: two shadowy figures conspiring under an oak tree in the moonlight

facts.fact: 速写：一只女性的手握刀，血从刀口滴下
facts.anchor: a knife held by a feminine hand, blood dripping from its edge

facts.fact: 着火的棚子让她想起 Gazzie 的纵火自白，但她判定大概只是巧合
facts.anchor: The shed reminded me of Gazzie’s arson confession, but that was, I decided, probably coincidence

facts.fact: 她给这些画两种解释：白日梦，或噩梦
facts.anchor: They must have been daydreams. Or nightmares

facts.fact: 下一页让她脊背发凉
facts.anchor: The next page sent a chill down my spine

facts.fact: 画：Ida 的脸的特写，但这版她在咧嘴笑，满嘴太多颗牙
facts.anchor: this version of her grinned, mouth full of too many teeth

facts.fact: 鲜红的角冠在她头上
facts.anchor: and bright red horns crowned her head

facts.fact: 她的推断：Leon 那个夏天开始画他的 Ida 仿像
facts.anchor: Leon must have begun painting his mimicries of Ida that summer

facts.fact: 但这幅比餐厅里那些不克制得多
facts.anchor: though this one was much less subtle than those in the dining room

facts.fact: 她在 Ida 头顶上方写了一行弧形的字
facts.anchor: In an arc above her head, he’d written

facts.fact: 弧线文字：Greer 家的人心里天生带一个魔鬼
facts.anchor: Greers are born with a devil in their hearts

facts.fact: 隔壁有什么撞了墙，她吓了一跳
facts.anchor: Something in the next room bumped the wall, and I jumped in my seat

facts.fact: 深呼吸几口，压住从窗口爬出去逃回 patio 的冲动
facts.anchor: I repressed the urge to climb out the window and flee to the patio

facts.fact: 她给自己台阶：Greer House 又老又回响
facts.anchor: Greer House was old and echoey

facts.fact: 她弃用 supernatural 这个词，改用 woo-woo
facts.anchor: I dismissed the word supernatural, instead landing on woo-woo

facts.fact: 它伤不了我
facts.anchor: it couldn’t hurt me

facts.fact: 它以前没伤过任何人——是吗
facts.anchor: It hadn’t hurt anyone before. Had it?

facts.fact: 即便自我体操之后，探头看客厅仍用尽她全部力气
facts.anchor: Even after my mental gymnastics, it took everything in me to peer into the parlor

facts.fact: 没人；只有 Ida 的画像回看她，嘴扯成那副挑战式的笑
facts.anchor: Only Ida’s portrait stared back at me, her mouth pulled into that challenging smile

facts.fact: 肩膀松下来，她回到速写本
facts.anchor: My shoulders relaxed, and I returned to the sketchbook

facts.fact: 她想起上次听到怪声时她也在翻 Leon 的东西，但那多半又是一个巧合
facts.anchor: The last time I’d heard strange sounds, I’d also been looking through Leon’s things, but surely that was just another coincidence

facts.fact: Ida 首次出现之后，他的画恶化得更快
facts.anchor: After Ida’s first appearance, Leon’s drawings devolved even more

facts.fact: 下一页：黑眼睛从一团红色乱线里往外看
facts.anchor: black eyes peered out from a red cloud of scribbles

facts.fact: 短记：我想她在画像里
facts.anchor: I think she’s in the portrait

facts.fact: 接着是 Greer House 的精细线描，有处不对劲她说不出来
facts.anchor: an intricate line drawing of Greer House, something off about it that I couldn’t place

facts.fact: 她凑近，鼻尖几乎贴上纸
facts.anchor: I leaned closer, nose almost touching the paper

facts.fact: 句子被她的动作切断：墙是由……她皱眉后靠回椅背——骨头
facts.anchor: The walls were made of…I frowned and leaned back in the chair. Bones

facts.fact: 短记：就像 Caroline 说的；Greer 家把家业建在鳄鱼骨上
facts.anchor: It’s like Caroline says. The Greers built their fortune on alligator bones

facts.fact: 短记续：那样的过去逃不掉，除非心里不带一点魔鬼
facts.anchor: Can’t escape a past like that without a bit of the devil in you

facts.fact: 短记末：她觉得好笑，我觉得是真的
facts.anchor: She thinks it’s funny, but I think it’s true

facts.fact: 她第一次看到 Mama 衣柜墙上那句时的直觉是对的：那句没写完
facts.anchor: The first time I’d seen the phrase inscribed on Mama’s closet wall, my instinct had been correct: It hadn’t been finished

facts.fact: Mama 只写了前半句
facts.anchor: She’d only written the first part

facts.fact: Mama 的声音滑进她耳朵：你最好把你心里那个魔鬼驯住
facts.anchor: Her voice slipped into my ear: You’d better tame that devil in you, girl

facts.fact: 她急忙翻页
facts.anchor: Hurriedly, I flipped the page

facts.fact: 最后一条不是画，而是页面正中涂的一行字
facts.anchor: His final entry was no drawing at all but a phrase scribbled in the center of the page

facts.fact: 终条：我要让她放我走，不然为这去死
facts.anchor: I’ll make her let me go or die trying

facts.fact: 她感觉脸上的血在退、头发轻
facts.anchor: I could feel the blood draining from my face, my head lightening

facts.fact: 她把速写本抱在胸口急忙上楼，一路说服自己反应过度
facts.anchor: Sketchbook clutched to my chest, I hurried upstairs, trying to convince myself I was overreacting

facts.fact: 她给的解释：Leon 显然是在戏剧化
facts.anchor: Uncle Leon was being dramatic, obviously

facts.fact: 他不可能预见到自己的意外死亡
facts.anchor: He couldn’t have predicted his accidental death

facts.fact: 紧接着独立成句的反问：除非那不是意外
facts.anchor: Unless it wasn’t an accident

facts.fact: 念头一冒出来她就把它赶跑
facts.anchor: As soon as the thought surfaced, I banished it

facts.fact: 她据怪句与魔鬼化的 Ida 判断：那个夏天他正在失去对现实的把握
facts.anchor: Uncle Leon had been losing his grip on reality that summer

facts.fact: 但那两个词在她脑后进颤：Die trying
facts.anchor: But those two words quivered in the back of my mind. Die trying

facts.fact: 快速冲了个澡定神，决定早上不那么累时重读
facts.anchor: After a quick shower to settle my nerves, I decided to reread the sketchbook in the morning

facts.fact: 她把本子放在床头柜上；那是她戴上眼罩睡前列看到的最后一样东西
facts.anchor: I placed it on my nightstand; it was the last thing I saw before I slipped on my eye mask and fell asleep

facts.fact: 某处开着的窗口吹进一阵凉风，她往被子里钻得更深以躲开那股凉
facts.anchor: A cool breeze blew from an open window somewhere, and I burrowed deeper under the covers, away from the chill

facts.fact: Greer House 熟悉的嗡鸣在日出前很早把她叫醒
facts.anchor: Greer House’s familiar hum woke me well before sunrise

facts.fact: 她试着忽略，直到酸掉的茉莉味进到鼻子里
facts.anchor: when the scent of sour jasmine reached my nose, I ripped off my eye mask

facts.fact: 耳机早已滑掉
facts.anchor: my headphones had already slid off

facts.fact: 她只来得及看到一个黑色形状滑进浴室的末梢
facts.anchor: in time to see the tail end of a black shape slip into the bathroom

facts.fact: 随后是水龙头被拧开的声音
facts.anchor: Then came the sound of the faucet turning on

facts.fact: 她的嘴自动张开，但她忍住了没叫
facts.anchor: My mouth automatically opened, but I stopped myself from screaming

facts.fact: 理由：她不能再在 Gazzie 面前出丑
facts.anchor: I couldn’t embarrass myself in front of Gazzie again

facts.fact: 因为她之前已经误判太多次
facts.anchor: not when I’d been mistaken so many times before

facts.fact: 太阳穴在跳，她无声下床摸向浴室
facts.anchor: Pulse throbbing in my temple, I silently slipped out of bed and crept toward the bathroom

facts.fact: 脑中在排入侵者：一个走错路的贼、Harrison、Ida Greer
facts.anchor: images of intruders shuffled through my mind: a misguided thief. Harrison. Ida Greer

facts.fact: 又一次：没人在
facts.anchor: Yet again, no one was there

facts.fact: 她瘫在门框上，享受从半开的浴室窗吹来的凉气
facts.anchor: I sagged against the doorframe, savoring the cool air blowing from the cracked bathroom window

facts.fact: 她想也许该去开安眠药处方，把噩梦掐在芽里
facts.anchor: Maybe it was time for a sleeping pill prescription. Nip these nightmares in the bud

facts.fact: 然后她的目光落在洗手盆上
facts.anchor: Then my eyes fell on the sink

facts.fact: Leon 的速写本摊开在仍在流水的水龙头下
facts.anchor: Uncle Leon’s sketchbook lay open under the still-running faucet

facts.fact: 纸页湿透，水发灰
facts.anchor: The pages were soaked, the water gray

facts.fact: 她一声惊叫把它捞起，用毛巾按纸页
facts.anchor: With a yelp, I yanked it up and dabbed at the pages with a towel

facts.fact: 本子了：只有前面几页还看得清
facts.anchor: It was ruined, only a few of the first pages still clear

facts.fact: 其余——困扰过她的那些图和字、她打算回头再看的那些——糊成一团墨与铅笔
facts.anchor: were a mess of blended ink and pencil

facts.fact: 她哀叫着一页页抬起湿纸
facts.anchor: lifting page after soggy page

facts.fact: 她认定：Leon 最后几个月的记录没了
facts.anchor: The last months of Leon’s life, lost

facts.fact: 随之而来的问题：她怎么能相信自己记得的东西
facts.anchor: How could I trust what I remembered?

facts.fact: 抖停止后她开始做那件注定失败的活儿：吹干纸页
facts.anchor: begun the doomed task of blow-drying the pages

facts.fact: 她的核对：睡以前本子确实在床头柜上
facts.anchor: The sketchbook had been on my nightstand before I’d fallen asleep. I was sure of that

facts.fact: 可它的摆放像是她留在洗手盆旁、自己掉进水里
facts.anchor: it had been positioned like I’d left it beside the sink and it had accidentally fallen in

facts.fact: 但她没让水开着；她是从床上听见水被拧开
facts.anchor: But I hadn’t left the water running. I’d heard it turn on from my bed

facts.fact: 她的结论：有人从床头柜取走本子、放进水盆、开水、再设法溜走，可能从浴室窗口
facts.anchor: Someone had taken the sketchbook from my nightstand, put it in the sink, turned on the water, and somehow snuck out, maybe through the bathroom window
